Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator introduced an incorrect Tropicos ID (a UUID) and arbitrarily took the first nine numeric characters to form the ISBN-10 base instead of using the actual numeric Tropicos ID for Helotiales. This wrong input sequence led to computing the check digit for the wrong number, producing 1 instead of the correct 3.
